camel_example: aliyun vod SetMessageCallback --region cn-hangzhou --CallbackURL 'http://developer.aliyundoc.com' --MnsEndpoint 'http://0000.mns.cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/' --AuthSwitch on --CallbackType HTTP --AppId 'app-1000000' --EventTypeList FileUploadComplete --AuthKey Dsf346dvet --MnsQueueName quene_name
description_en: Sets the callback method, callback URL, and event types for event notifications
description_zh: 调用本接口设置事件通知的回调方式、回调地址、事件类型
kebab_example: aliyun vod set-message-callback --callback-type HTTP --callback-url http://developer.aliyundoc.com --event-type-list FileUploadComplete --auth-switch on --auth-key Dsf346dvet --mns-endpoint http://0000.mns.cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/ --mns-queue-name quene_name --app-id app-1000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetMessageCallback

parameters.help_en:
The callback method. Valid values:
HTTP
Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS)
parameters.help_zh:
回调方式，取值：
HTTP
轻量消息队列（原MNS）
parameters.name: callback_type

parameters.help_en:
The callback URL. This parameter is required when the callback method is set to HTTP.
The callback URL cannot exceed 256 bytes in length. Multiple callback URLs are not supported
parameters.help_zh:
回调地址。回调方式为HTTP时，需设置此参数。
回调地址URL的长度不能超过256个字节，不支持设置多个回调地址
parameters.name: callback_url

parameters.help_en:
The event types for callbacks. If this parameter is left empty, all notifications are disabled. If this parameter is set to ALL, all notifications are enabled. You can also specify specific event types, separated by commas (,). For the valid event types, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55627.html.

<props="china">
All AI-related events such as AIMediaAuditComplete and AIMediaDNAComplete use the value AIComplete.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
回调事件类型，取值为空时关闭所有消息通知，取值为ALL时开启全部消息通知。也可指定开启某些消息通知，多个事件类型之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。可设置的事件类型取值范围请参见：https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55627.html。

<props="china">
所有AI相关事件即AIMediaAuditComplete、AIMediaDNAComplete等取值都为AIComplete。</props>
parameters.name: event_type_list

parameters.help_en:
The authentication switch for HTTP callbacks. This parameter takes effect only when the callback method is set to HTTP. Valid values:
on: enabled.
off: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
HTTP回调的鉴权开关，回调方式设置为HTTP时，此参数有效。取值：
on（启用）
off（不启用）
parameters.name: auth_switch

parameters.help_en: The authentication key. The key can be up to 32 characters in length and must contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, and digits. This parameter can be set when the callback method is HTTP
parameters.help_zh: 鉴权Key，最长32位，必须同时包含大小写字母和数字。回调方式为HTTP时，可设置此参数
parameters.name: auth_key

parameters.help_en: The public endpoint of Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS). This parameter is required when the callback method is set to Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS). Log on to the Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS) console (https://account.aliyun.com/login/login.html) and click the Get Endpoint button in the upper-right corner to obtain the endpoint. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27480.html
parameters.help_zh: 消息队列公网Endpoint，回调方式为轻量消息队列（原MNS）时，需设置此参数。可登录消息服务控制台 (https://account.aliyun.com/login/login.html)，单击右上角的获取Endpoint按钮获取。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27480.html
parameters.name: mns_endpoint

parameters.help_en: The name of the message queue. Log on to the Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS) console (https://account.aliyun.com/login/login.html) and view the queue in the Queue List. This parameter is required when the callback method is set to Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS)
parameters.help_zh: 消息队列名称，可登录消息服务控制台 (https://account.aliyun.com/login/login.html)，在队列列表中查看。回调方式为轻量消息队列（原MNS）时，需设置此参数
parameters.name: mns_queue_name

parameters.help_en: The application ID. If this parameter is not specified, the ID of the default application is used, which is the fixed value: app-1000000
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID。不传时为系统默认应用的ID，取固定值：app-1000000
parameters.name: app_id
